projects.name: Shear Genius
projects.tagline: Custom website + online booking for a local barbershop
projects.problem: A local barbershop in Hawthorne, CA had no real online presence. Customers couldn't find services, pricing, or hours, and booking only happened by phone or walk-in.
projects.solution: Designed and built a custom HTML/CSS website (Home, About, Services, Contact), wrote out the full service menu and pricing, and integrated a Booksy booking widget so customers can self-schedule online. Connected the site to the shop's Instagram, Facebook, and Yelp.
projects.result: The shop now has a professional, branded web presence with self-serve online booking. The site is live and the relationship is ongoing. I remain the go-to contact for updates and support.

projects.name: CSM Junk Removal
projects.tagline: Lead-generation site with CRM-driven quote requests across 9+ cities
projects.problem: A junk removal company serving 9+ Inland Empire cities needed a site that could generate and capture leads automatically, without a dedicated marketing or ops team.
projects.solution: Built out the site on a CRM-integrated platform (HighLevel/LeadConnector), including service area pages, pricing tiers, testimonials, a photo gallery, Google Maps integration, and a quote-request form with file upload and SMS opt-in.
projects.result: The business now has an automated lead pipeline (quote requests flow into the CRM and trigger SMS follow-up) covering 9+ service areas. The site is live and the client relationship is active.

projects.name: Stephens/T.A. Upshaw Scholarship Foundation
projects.tagline: Public site for a volunteer-run scholarship nonprofit
projects.problem: An all-volunteer 501(c)(3) scholarship foundation needed an accessible website to publicize scholarships, accept donations through multiple channels, and share downloadable applications, without any technical staff.
projects.solution: Built and customized the site on GoDaddy's website builder: organized scholarship eligibility, requirements, and the April 30 deadline, set up multi-channel donation info (PayPal, CashApp, mail, payroll deduction), added downloadable PDF applications, and a newsletter signup.
projects.result: The foundation has a clear, navigable site for applicants and donors that the volunteer board can maintain themselves. Live, active client relationship.

general.about: I didn't take a traditional path into tech. I learned by doing. While working a full-time job, I started teaching myself web development and used cold outreach to land my first paying clients. Since then, I've built and shipped real websites for a barbershop, a junk removal company, and a nonprofit foundation, handling everything from the first conversation to the live site and everything after. I lean heavily on AI tools to learn faster and work more efficiently, but the judgment, communication, and follow-through are mine. I'm looking for a role where that combination (technical ability, client communication, and the drive to figure things out) is the asset.

contact.blurb: Happy to talk about how my freelance experience translates to your team.
